findings.summary: The unconditional RUN_STATE_VERSION bump to 8 left two stale literal pins at 7 in the heavy QA suites, so the deterministic suite the pre-ship gate runs failed on the round-1 candidate.
findings.evidence: Grep over src/ for `version).toBe(` and `RUN_STATE_VERSION` on this candidate shows `src/qa-orchestration.test.ts:1028: expect(state.version).toBe(8);` and `src/qa-orchestration-gates.test.ts:1043: expect(bumped.version).toBe(8);` — both refreshed by commit 1420222 ("test(qa): refresh the loaded run-state version pins to v8 (#301 QA-01, P-04)"), whose diff touches exactly one line in each file (`git diff --stat c246e3f~1..HEAD` shows `src/qa-orchestration-gates.test.ts | 2 +-` and `src/qa-orchestration.test.ts | 2 +-`). `pnpm run test:heavy:qa` on the candidate tree: `Test Files 2 passed (2) / Tests 59 passed (59) / Duration 169.45s / [suite-time] qa-orchestration: 170.4s / [exited with code 0]`. No superseded pin remains: every other `RUN_STATE_VERSION` reader in the tree either compares against the exported constant or asserts 8 (src/eval-boundary.test.ts:130, src/run-state.test.ts:994/1210/1314/1485, src/self-audit.test.ts:326/343).
findings.expected: `pnpm run test:heavy:qa` passes on the candidate tree, with no assertion in src/qa-orchestration.test.ts or src/qa-orchestration-gates.test.ts pinning a superseded RUN_STATE_VERSION literal.
findings.observed: Both pins now read 8, each as a one-line change with the surrounding approvedBaselines, appliedWaivers and #91 baseline-locator assertions untouched, and `pnpm run test:heavy:qa` exits 0 with 59 tests passing. The contract's `## Files expected to change` and the acceptance manifest's fileScope both now declare the two paths, so the change is inside the locked file list.
findings.clearCondition: `pnpm run test:heavy:qa` passes on the candidate tree, with no assertion in src/qa-orchestration.test.ts or src/qa-orchestration-gates.test.ts pinning a superseded RUN_STATE_VERSION literal.
